description: Output of ``tutor_web`` v2: the answer plus a summary of every page read.

segments.description: The answer in reading order; [] if nothing reliable found.

text.description: One or two sentences of the answer, supported by the cited pages.

urls.description: https URLs of the authoritative pages actually read. Never empty.

pages.description: One entry per cited page, summarising what it states.

url.description: https URL of a page actually read (WebFetch).

summary.description: What the page states that is relevant to the question, in plain prose.
